主要内容: Monster Worldwide, Inc. (MWW) reported third quarter 2016 financial results, showing a 13% year-over-year decline in revenue from continuing operations to $144.8 million. Revenue from Careers – North America operations fell 16% to $99.7 million, while Careers – International revenue dropped 6% to $45.0 million. Total GAAP operating expenses were $338.0 million, including $182.2 million in non-cash goodwill impairment charges. Net loss from continuing operations was $180.5 million, or $2.03 per share, compared to a net income of $9.8 million, or $0.10 per share, in the same period last year. Non-GAAP net loss was $4.7 million, or $0.05 per share, versus a net income of $9.7 million, or $0.11 per share, in the prior year. The company also announced a definitive agreement with Randstad Holding nv (AMS: RAND) for a $3.40 per share cash acquisition, expected to close in Q4 2016. Monster suspended prior guidance and will not hold a conference call for the results due to the pending transaction.
